note: transformers>=5.x removed TrainingArguments.warmup_ratio; it merged into warmup_steps (float): values >=1 are an absolute step count, values <1 are treated as a ratio of num_training_steps. Passing warmup_ratio=0.1 now raises TypeError. Any existing script (e.g. train_run.py) written against the older API must be updated to warmup_steps=0.1 before it will run.
